'''RS-33''' was an [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] developed by rogue [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] aboard the [[X7-Cratus]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. It was meant to use against the [[Eternal Alliance]], following its [[War against Zakuul|victory]] against the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Uprising: Trial and Error}}</ref>
